Check out a branch further up in the stack (further from the trunk).
Merged branches are automatically skipped.

Usage:
  gh stack up [n] [flags]

Examples:
  # Move one branch up
  $ gh stack up

  # Move three branches up
  $ gh stack up 3

Flags:
  -h, --help         help for up
      --print-path   Print the target worktree path without switching a branch held elsewhere
